title: Erice to senators: Treat congressional budget 'insertions' as red flags
summary: Caloocan 2nd District Rep. Edgar Erice on Wednesday called on the Senate to treat all congressional "insertions" in the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget as red flags for further scrutiny.
